name: Hazing
overview: Scripture reveals God's desire to protect and heal His people from harm and brokenness, promising healing to those who obey His commandments and trust in Him (Exodus 15:26; Jeremiah 17:14). The Bible acknowledges the deep wounds caused by sin and suffering but points to Christ's sacrifice as the ultimate source of healing and peace (Isaiah 53:5). A joyful and trusting heart is portrayed as beneficial to spiritual and physical well-being, contrasting with the damage of a broken spirit (Proverbs 17:22; Psalms 147:3). God's love, demonstrated through the gift of His Son, offers eternal life and restoration to all who believe (John 3:16).
